title: Research Chamber
keywords: Studies a sample and unlocks its category for the owner or configured shared research state

blocks.text: Studies a sample and unlocks its category for the owner or configured shared research state.

rows: Place the chamber with a valid owner.
Insert a sample listed in Research.
Supply study energy and wait for completion.
Read the unlock message and retry the newly available recipe.

blocks.text: A sample for an already unlocked group will not repeatedly create rewards. Sample consumption is a separate server option.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
